newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian life insurance firm Salim raises capital.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian life insurance firm Salim raises capital.

text.p: Tunisian life insurance firm Societe Tunisienne d'Assurances Vie et de Capitalisation "Salim", a unit of housing bank Banque de l'Habitat, said it was raising its capital to four million from one million dinars.

The firm said current shareholders have priority to subscribe to the 30,000 news shares issued worth 100 dinars each. The remainDer would be offered to the public from May 25, it added in a statement received on Tuesday.
